title: Measure stage-aware Context Capsule effectiveness
scope: Build a generation-free, fail-closed A/B harness comparing legacy-expanded and stage-aware context on matched single-repository and coordinator-led multi-repository cold handoffs.
Retain source bytes, selection digests, correctness, Provider Token categories, latency, tool output, human intervention, and rework without retaining prompts or hidden reasoning.
Freeze an exact live protocol and require exact human approval before any Provider generation.
acceptance_criteria: The protocol isolates context treatment while holding task, repository revisions, model, effort, retry, fallback, and evaluator rules constant.
Generation-free rehearsal proves matched fixtures, route differences, output schemas, command policy, cleanup, and stopped-run preservation before approval can unlock generation.
The analyzer reports single-repository and multi-repository results separately and never turns one sample per condition into a general savings claim.
Independent QA reproduces the exact candidate and verifies all published calculations.

profile_assessment.rationale: A bounded local experiment with an external Provider gate; standard workflow preserves evaluation and independent QA.
